_mockNote: Representative mock data for POC demonstration. No real DB connection was made. Set DB_SERVER, DB_DATABASE, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD in src/config/.env and run 'npm run ai:db:check' to replace with live results.

checks.name: Orphaned Invoice Lines
checks.description: Invoice lines that reference a non-existent invoice header. Indicates a partial delete or failed rollback.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM invoice_lines il WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.id = il.invoice_id)

checks.name: Orphaned Purchase Order Lines
checks.description: PO lines referencing a non-existent purchase order header.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM purchase_order_lines pol WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_orders po WHERE po.id = pol.purchase_order_id)

checks.name: Orphaned Journal Entries
checks.description: Journal detail lines referencing a non-existent journal header. Can cause reporting discrepancies.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM journal_entries je WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_headers jh WHERE jh.id = je.journal_id)

checks.name: Budget Virements Without Authorisation
checks.description: Approved budget virements with no matching authorisation record. Indicates a data-integrity or workflow failure.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM budget_virements bv WHERE bv.status = 'Approved' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM authorisations a WHERE a.entity_id = bv.id AND a.entity_type = 'BudgetVirement')

checks.name: Transactions With Invalid Financial Year
checks.description: Transactions referencing a financial year ID that does not exist. This is the primary cause of missing transaction reports and year-end discrepancies.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM transactions t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial_years fy WHERE fy.id = t.financial_year_id)

checks.name: Transactions With Null Nominal Code
checks.description: Posted transactions missing a nominal (cost) code. Will not appear in budget reports.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM transactions WHERE nominal_code IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(nominal_code AS NVARCHAR))) = '' AND status = 'Posted'

checks.name: Transactions Referencing Unknown Nominal Code
checks.description: Transactions using a nominal code not present in the chart of accounts. Silent mispostings.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM transactions t WHERE t.nominal_code IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nominal_codes nc WHERE nc.code = t.nominal_code)

checks.name: Missing Bank Reconciliation References
checks.description: Bank reconciliation entries with no matching transaction reference. Indicates a failed reconcile commit.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM bank_reconciliation_entries bre WHERE bre.transaction_ref IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(bre.transaction_ref)) = ''

checks.name: Purchase Orders Stuck in Submitted State
checks.description: POs in 'Submitted' status for more than 24 hours without approval action. Often a race condition in the approval workflow.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM purchase_orders WHERE status = 'Submitted' AND last_modified_date < DATEADD(hour, -24, GETUTCDATE())

checks.name: Invoices With Null Approval Status
checks.description: Non-draft invoices missing an approval_status value. Will be excluded from the invoice liability report.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM invoices WHERE approval_status IS NULL AND invoice_status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled')

checks.name: Duplicate Financial Year Labels
checks.description: More than one financial_years record with the same label. The root cause of year-ID mismatches between environments.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM (SELECT financial_year_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM financial_years GROUP BY financial_year_label HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS dupes

checks.name: Users Assigned to Inactive Cost Centres
checks.description: User cost centre mappings pointing to deleted or inactive cost centres. Causes 'input repopulated/emptied' symptoms in the budget screens.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM user_cost_centres ucc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cost_centres cc WHERE cc.id = ucc.cost_centre_id AND cc.is_active = 1)

checks.name: Closed Financial Year Still Accepting Transactions
checks.description: Transactions posted against a financial year marked as closed. A data-integrity failure that can cause year-end imbalance.
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM transactions t INNER JOIN financial_years fy ON fy.id = t.financial_year_id WHERE fy.is_closed = 1 AND t.created_date > fy.close_date

actionItems: Investigate 7 orphaned invoice_lines rows — likely caused by a partial test teardown or failed rollback in the invoice deletion flow.
Resolve 12 transactions referencing an invalid financial year ID — cross-check financial_years table for missing or mismatched year labels between UAT and TRAINING.
Fix 5 posted transactions with null nominal codes — these will be silently excluded from all budget and cost-centre reports until corrected.
Audit 3 orphaned journal entries against journal_headers — may indicate an interrupted journal posting during the test run.
Review the net loss of 12 rows in the transactions table during the test run — confirm this is expected test cleanup, not accidental data deletion.
executiveSummary: 4 integrity checks failed across 13 checks run against SIMSFinance_UAT. 2 critical violations were detected: 7 orphaned invoice lines (partial rollback risk) and 12 transactions referencing an invalid financial year (reporting gap risk). Additionally, 3 orphaned journal entries and 5 posted transactions with null nominal codes were found. Row count analysis shows the transactions table lost 12 rows during the test run — requires investigation to rule out data loss. The invoice_lines and journal_entries tables each gained rows, indicating possible test data not cleaned up. These issues collectively represent a medium-to-high risk to finance report accuracy and should be investigated before the next UAT sign-off cycle.
